notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 日历新增经期记录、逐日经量与下次经期预测，每次更正自动更新估计；可选伴侣共享和个人提醒。包含 0.3.2 的日记文字与图片回复。
notes.en: Adds period dates, daily flow and next-period estimates in Calendar, recalculated after every edit, with optional partner sharing and personal reminders. Includes the text and photo diary replies from 0.3.2.
